text:
sam: opened PR #4972 to publish the 'action-envelope' migration guide + py/js snippets. tagging @nora @jia for quick review. preview: https://deploy-preview.example.com/4972

nora: quick skim looks solid. one ask: make `args` optional in the example schema and include a legacy fallback using header `X-Action`. a one-line curl will help.

jia: tiny SDK note: examples should use `client.action_call(...)` (py) and `client.actionCall()` (js). I'll open a small fix PR to update snippets.

sam: added a curl fallback and a minimal parser sketch in the PR comments. guardrails section: recommend `metadata.request_id` for telemetry and `confidence >= 0.65` before auto-execution; require human-review flag for destructive actions.

nora: QA requested a small prompt set (4 prompts) to cover envelope / missing args / malformed-json / freeform. jia will push tests.

jia: pushed regression prompts in #4976 and updated snippet names in #4977. CI passed.

docs-bot: PR #4972 checks passed. ready to merge.

sam: merging now, thanks everyone :rocket:
